rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Rent Increase Limits
rules.requirement: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage. Effective February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities or for an additional dependent added to the tenancy. A 10% increase is allowed for an additional tenant (not a dependent) if they move into the rental unit, with rent increases allowed within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by allowable percentage; no utilities increase; no additional dependent increase; 10% for additional tenant
rules.summary_plain: In Los Angeles, rent can only be increased once a year by a set percentage. You cannot be charged extra for utilities or for an added dependent, but landlords can raise rent by 10% if a new tenant (not a dependent) moves in.
rules.summary_plain_es: En Los Ángeles, la renta solo puede aumentarse una vez al año por un porcentaje establecido. No se puede cobrar extra por servicios públicos o por un dependiente adicional, pero los propietarios pueden aumentar la renta en un 10% si un nuevo inquilino (no dependiente) se muda.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental properties in the City of Los Angeles subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, generally those built on or before October 1, 1978.
rules.exemptions_text: Condominiums and townhomes with tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995 are not rent regulated under the RSO.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 151.00 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF). Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities. Effective February 2, 2026, an additional 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy is no longer permitted. However, a 10% for an additional tenant is allowed (not a dependent) if moves into a rental unit: Landlords can increase the rent within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Just Cause Eviction
rules.requirement: Evictions under the RSO must be for legal reasons including tenant fault such as failure to pay rent or lease violations, or no-fault reasons such as owner or family move-in, demolition, government order, or conversion to affordable housing.
rules.summary_plain: In Los Angeles, landlords can only evict tenants for specific legal reasons like not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord or family needs to move in.
rules.summary_plain_es: En Los Ángeles, los propietarios solo pueden desalojar a los inquilinos por razones legales específicas como no pagar la renta, incumplir el contrato o si el propietario o su familia necesitan mudarse.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental properties in the City of Los Angeles subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, generally those built on or before October 1, 1978.
rules.quoted_span: Legal Reasons for Eviction Tenant is at-fault Failure to pay rent Failure to fix or address a violation of the rental agreement Creating a nuisance or causing damage to the rental unit Using the rental unit for an illegal purpose Failure to renew a similar rental agreement Failure to provide the landlord with reasonable access to the rental unit The person at the end of the lease term is a subtenant not approved by the landlord Tenant is not at-fault The owner or immediate family member will move into the rental unit A resident manager will move into the rental unit Demolition and permanent removal from the rental market Government order Conversion to affordable housing

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Security Deposit Interest Payments
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits held under the RSO.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a unit covered by the Los Angeles RSO, your landlord must pay you interest on your security deposit.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila una unidad cubierta por la Ordenanza de Estabilización de Rentas de Los Ángeles, su propietario debe pagarle intereses sobre su depósito de seguridad.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental properties in the City of Los Angeles subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, generally those built on or before October 1, 1978.
